create_video_prep_msc_cj: create a VideoPrep_MSC_CJ instance to apply random resized crop, horizontal flip, and color jitter to video frames
create_video_prep_crop_cj: create a VideoPrep_Crop_CJ instance to resize, randomly crop, and apply color jitter augmentation to video frames
create_audio_prep: create an AudioPrep instance to trim, pad, downmix to mono, and optionally augment audio signal volume
create_log_spectrogram: create a LogSpectrogram instance to compute log-scale spectrograms from audio signals using librosa STFT
review_video_prep_classes: review the VideoPrep_MSC_CJ and VideoPrep_Crop_CJ classes for video frame preprocessing and augmentation pipelines
